title: Digital Premium trial and add-on pricing
summary: Feedback centers on Digital Premium as a paid add-on with a short trial, with clear dissatisfaction about paying to keep features and many comments that describe expiry or pricing without a fully classifiable sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise liking Digital Premium or the vehicle's premium feel, though the examples are limited and partly mix software and overall vehicle impressions.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the paid Digital Premium content as poor and object to having to buy it as an add-on.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback says the car is acceptable overall but specifically resents paying to activate Premium Digital features.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews often mention the three-month trial ending, unclear communication, pricing, and paid feature continuation, but the samples do not always provide a clearly assigned polarity.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits how specifically the sentiment split can be summarized from examples alone.
The topic includes both Digital Premium subscription comments and at least one broader 'premium vehicle' remark, so the cluster is not fully uniform.
Some negative-sounding examples are assigned undetermined sentiment, so the summary must follow the provided labels rather than reinterpret every fragment.
